digest.overview: Open-weight advocacy hit Washington with a major industry letter; Black Forest Labs dropped FLUX 3 multimodal flow models; Hugging Face shipped The Stack v3 code corpus and swiss-ai released Apertus 70B/8B.

top_story.headline: Microsoft, NVIDIA, Meta, IBM, Palantir lead open-weights letter to Washington
top_story.summary: Joint letter argues open weights are foundational to US AI leadership, expand access, and keep models economically sustainable.
top_story.why_it_matters: Direct industry pushback against potential restrictions on open-weight models, signed by hardware and cloud leaders.

sentiment.label: bullish
sentiment.summary: Community excited by FLUX 3 multimodal release and coordinated open-weights defense; focus on practical model drops over hype.

model_releases.headline: Black Forest Labs releases FLUX 3 multimodal flow model
model_releases.summary: One model handles image, video, audio and action prediction; beats Seedance 2.0, Gemini Omni, Grok Imagine on real-world tasks.

model_releases.headline: Hugging Face ships The Stack v3
model_releases.summary: Largest open code dataset yet: near-deduplicated, quality-filtered, PII-redacted train split ready for load_dataset.

model_releases.headline: swiss-ai releases Apertus-v1.5 70B and 8B
model_releases.summary: Fully open, transparent, multilingual/multimodal models targeting broad language coverage.

frontier_labs.headline: NVIDIA hosts South Korea AI Summit with President Lee
frontier_labs.summary: Korean government and business leaders outline national AI roadmap with NVIDIA ecosystem partners.

frontier_labs.headline: Industry coalition files open-weights letter
frontier_labs.summary: Microsoft, NVIDIA, Meta, IBM, Palantir and others warn against policies that would restrict open-weight models.

influencer_takes.author: Ethan Mollick
influencer_takes.quote: Glad to see Google sharing data on how Gemini is being used. Especially interesting is that the usefulness of multimodal AI for manual labor may be greater than expected.
influencer_takes.context: Highlights rare public usage data on multimodal value in physical work contexts.

research_radar.headline: JAXBench: Benchmarking autonomous TPU kernel optimization
research_radar.summary: First TPU-native benchmark suite for AI-generated kernel search, filling gap left by GPU-focused suites.

research_radar.headline: InferenceBench: Benchmark for open-ended LLM inference optimization by AI agents
research_radar.summary: New benchmark targets agent-driven, open-ended inference optimization workflows beyond prescribed tasks.

post_ideas.hook: Open weights just got a heavyweight coalition
post_ideas.draft: Microsoft, NVIDIA, Meta, IBM, Palantir et al. just told Washington: kill open-weight models and you kill US AI leadership. The letter is short and direct.
post_ideas.why_viral: Timely policy tension with big names; readers love seeing industry pushback framed clearly.

post_ideas.hook: FLUX 3 drops as true multimodal backbone
post_ideas.draft: Black Forest Labs FLUX 3: single flow model for image/video/audio/action prediction that reportedly beats Seedance 2.0, Gemini Omni and Grok Imagine. HN thread is live.
post_ideas.why_viral: Surprise multimodal leap from a lab already known for strong image models; concrete benchmark claims.

post_ideas.draft: Hugging Face just released The Stack v3, the largest open code dataset: near-deduplicated, PII-redacted, ready to load. Anton Lozhkov posted the links.
post_ideas.why_viral: Direct tooling win for local/open training; community always engages with new high-quality datasets.
